narr: A quasi-stationary boundary was in place over southwest Pennsylvania on May 24th. Taking advantage of an abundance of moisture and upper shortwave support, showers and thunderstorms developed and tracked along the boundary. A couple of flooding events occurred in the urbanized areas of Allegheny County.
ev: A female was rescued after her car became stuck in high water near the Verizon Building at 590 Union Avenue.
Flooding occurred at the intersection of Shady Lane and Delafield Road in Fox Chapel.
